How to play

Guess today’s five-letter word in six tries. Each guess must be a valid word.

BRAVE

Green means the letter is in the right place.

SMILE

Gold means the letter is in the word, but in another place.

CLOUD

Gray means the letter is not in the word.

A new puzzle arrives each day at midnight.
